description.value: Bella Pizza is a family-owned pizzeria that has operated since 1979, originally on Denman Street in Vancouver before relocating to its current Burnaby spot on Imperial Street. The kitchen specializes in stone-baked, hand-tossed Italian-style pizzas using house-made tomato sauce and premium cheeses, alongside pastas, subs, wings, and salads. The restaurant has earned Reader's Choice recognition from both Vancouver Magazine and The Georgia Straight over its decades in business.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bellapizza.ca is active and corroborates the OSM address and phone number; however, the email on the website (bellapizza1979@gmail.com) differs from the OSM tag (bellapizzaimperial@gmail.com), and the opening hours on the website differ from those in OSM, suggesting OSM data is partially stale. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears in either the website content or OSM tags; OSM tags confirm takeaway and vegetarian options which the website supports.
